response.answer: Study treatment must be interrupted if ALT or AST is at or above 5 times ULN, and it must be permanently discontinued if ALT or AST is above 8 times ULN.

quotes.text: Study treatment must be interrupted if ALT or AST is at or above 5 times ULN. Study treatment must be permanently discontinued if ALT or AST is above 8 times ULN.
